Mother: Keep it open, Ella. It'll protect you from the owl.
Thin light falls into the abyss. The open umbrella's shadow follows her.
One clock hand is left. Its mounting is empty.
The hand's bronze shaft matches the umbrella's.
The owl's pursuit ends. He goes back into the darkness.
Ella is alive, but still suspended between worlds.
Perhaps the owl has only postponed his judgment.
